title: Vancouver Jetski Tour with Dinner on Bowen Island
blurb: Hit the throttle of a Sea-Doo watercraft out of English Bay, explore Howe Sound and then head to dinner at a local restaurant on Bowen Island. We invite you to stroll through the shops before we jump back in the boat to do more exploring. This guided evening Jetski tour from Granville Island includes wildlife sightseeing beforehand: think a large seal colony at Pam Rocks and migratory birds swooping overhead.
